adapter.manifest: {v:1,candidate,files:[...]}; candidate file rows include Git mode 100644 or 100755, unchanged files and deleted entries

checks: Independent local clone uses --no-hardlinks; source refs and files remain unchanged.
NUL-separated Git data captures add, edit, delete, rename, binary and executable-mode changes.
Tree digest uses canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted paths and sorted object keys.
Symlink, alternate object store, traversal, out-of-scope, oversize and credential-like inputs are rejected.
Git environment redirection, filters, hooks, textconv and external diff fixtures do not execute.
Delivery requires a separately hash-checked approval file under the configured approval root; repeated IDs reconcile and uncertain state blocks.

repair_attempt.finding: Worker-editable .git/config could be a hard link to a file outside configured roots and was truncated during freeze.
repair_attempt.resolution: All regular Git metadata files are now rejected when st_nlink is not 1. Metadata is traversed with no-follow directory descriptors. Safe config is written to a new single-link inode and installed by descriptor-relative atomic replacement; the old config is never opened with O_TRUNC.
regressions: Hard-linked .git/config causes typed POLICY_DENIED and preserves external sentinel bytes.
Hard-linked Git ref metadata is denied before Git operations.
Hard-linked progress log is denied and preserves external sentinel bytes; ordinary progress updates replace the file atomically.
repair_attempt.other_write_audit: Artifact, candidate snapshot, state, destination worktree and destination index writes now use checked directory descriptors, no-follow opens and atomic replacement where applicable.

limits: Credential detection is heuristic; encoded and unrecognized secret formats may not match.

The adapter is not an OS/container boundary against a malicious process running as the same user concurrently; the host must quiesce worker access during freeze and delivery and protect configured roots.
Immutable artifacts still require the host to verify and copy staged bytes by digest.
Local delivery was exercised only on disposable temporary Git fixtures; no real target was written.
No provider/model call, B2 work, GitHub operation or real repository delivery was run.
next_action: Coordinator freeze and independent fresh B1 review before any B2 work.
